map.DHI是眩晕/头晕最常用的生活质量评估量表，广泛用于BPPV、前庭神经炎、梅尼埃: DHI is the most commonly used quality-of-life scale for vertigo/dizziness, widely used for BPPV, vestibular neuritis, Meniere's disease, vestibular migraine and other vestibular disorders' assessment and efficacy follow-up. A total change ≥18 points is clinically meaningful improvement. Recommend combined vestibular function tests (caloric, vHIT, VEMP) for comprehensive assessment.
